scope: Source mathematical event semantics with declared observation/float enclosures; not formal equivalence of the C++ binary or a neural policy proof
complete_state: body/proxy p_xy,v_xy,q_xy and yaw/attitude output lifting
ordered delayed clipped position and velocity errors; sample identities and timestamps
publisher monotonic profile clock, next publication, gap and stream-end state
latest published message and last actual native read time/read-age/valid flag
external held position,velocity,yaw; use_internal_reference and active/previous_active
native hrt clock and independent gyro sample clock, duplicate/regression/early-return status
GRU/action, motor, estimator and vertical dynamics are not resolved by the surrogate; effects on its current-state update require the explicit conditional w bound
clock_order: runner evaluates monotonic profile; skips publication inside [gap_start,gap_end)
publisher sends latest message (UTC stamp is payload only, not timeout origin)
native Run obtains current_time=hrt_absolute_time and may read latest valid external setpoint
successful read sets timestamp_last_trajectory_setpoint=current_time, not publication stamp
after required valid sensor updates, compute stale using strict native read-age > 200000 us
capture if newly stale or newly active while stale; evaluate capture profile
run recovery transition with previous-stale/armed memory
sample-clock duplicate/regression rejection is AFTER capture/recovery transition, so those reference/module updates may already have occurred; such samples are outside the certified class
observe advances active virtual target using gyro sample time; control executor native action cadence may differ
declared surrogate advances on its own fixed integration grid; it is not an exact discretization of the neural executor

edges.guard: outside gap, before stream end, publisher period elapsed; gap exit immediate
edges.reset: new message r(profile_time),s(profile_time); profile time never pauses

edges.guard: external enabled, subscription updated, all required fields finite
edges.reset: held setpoint=message; last_read=current native hrt; last_read_set=true

edges.guard: no update or any required field nonfinite
edges.reset: last_read and held target unchanged; invalid counter if appropriate
stale=true; equality age=200000 alone is fresh
p0=observed body position, captured yaw=observed yaw, default target velocity=0; RTGT2 additionally v0=observed horizontal velocity; source floating casts enclosed
edges.relations: same captured body variables retained, not independently chosen post-state ball
edges.history: all previous delayed errors retained; only new observed errors use new target

edges.clock: t from gyro sample minus capture gyro sample

edges.reset: armed=false; active recovery ends with END_INACTIVE
activation clears armed, otherwise newly stale sets armed=true; active recovery ends END_STALE
armed=false; external target is read from the original advancing trajectory; no queue reset
virtual p,v=observed current horizontal body p,v; start_sample=last_sample=current gyro sample; active=true
a=2.25*(sp_p-vt_p)+3*(sp_v-vt_v), norm limited by RREC; vt_v+=a*dt; vt_p+=updated_v*dt
edges.clock: dt=clamp((gyro_sample-last_sample)*1e-6,0,.05), last_sample only advances on newer sample

edges.guard: position norm <.02 && velocity norm <.02 after virtual update
edges.reset: active=false; observe uses external target directly that cycle

edges.guard: any pre-profile stale->fresh with armed and RREC>0, or a prior active virtual target at initial state
edges.reset: same RECOVERY_START/STEP rules; must include even before first planned event
edges.certified_exclusion: initial recovery_active=false,previous_stale=false,armed=false; RREC=0; all pre-gap read ages <=16ms, so no such branch is reachable in certified class

edges.guard: missing/stale required sensors or unavailable angular update
edges.reset: source-specific early return before stale/capture processing; an earlier external read may already have updated the held setpoint/read clock
capture/profile/recovery transition may ALREADY have updated the module state; then return without observe/control; never treat this as an event-free skipped tick

verified_subclass.clock_binding: monotonic profile and native clocks advance 1:1 at declared times; no delivery loss; latest publisher value read at next native tick
verified_subclass.frame: NED-x, fixed target yaw=0, lateral proxy and disturbances identically zero
verified_subclass.initial_modules: valid fresh external message; capture/recovery inactive, previous stale and armed false; fresh activation does not capture
verified_subclass.other_classes: UNKNOWN; mapped RREC>0/recovery/extra-start branches are not silently treated as covered

clip_sector_analysis.piecewise_modes: position and velocity slopes each 0 or 1; threshold-crossing sets require all slopes/modes or a new remainder bound
clip_sector_analysis.global_obstacle: including sigma_position=sigma_velocity=0 leaves a position unit eigenvalue; no strict positive-definite one-step common decrease for every sector mode follows
clip_sector_analysis.this_certificate: finite-horizon trajectory-centered tube; proves entire set remains strictly unsaturated. Original raw P level is not enlarged or rescaled
clip_sector_analysis.saturated_candidates: retained as UNKNOWN for this certificate, never declared certain failures
